title: Cheap and inexpensive
text: Cheap and inexpensive. Got these on a clearance sale. Would never recommend at suggested retail. The induction design is crappy. The cooking surface is not totally flat. The glass lids are nice. The color is quirky and cute.

product_metadata.title: Stone Earth Nonstick Frying Pan, Nonstick Omelet Pan Skillet for All Stove Tops Include Induction Cooker, Stir Fry Pan with Heat Resistant Handle, APEO & PFOA-Free (Frying Pan, 10 inch-Pink)
features: 🍢[All-match with Foods and Variety of Stove Tops] If you own our 9.5 inch white & pink wok pan, then you will own colorful cooking experience. It is perfectly suitable for several stoves including induction stoves. You can also use it to saute, to poach, to fry or make soup. So colorful culinary life for you. Just be careful not to put this frying pan into the oven.

🍠[Superior Quality & Unique Appearence] This elegant wok pan comes with Aluminum alloy wrapped with ceramic nonstick layer, it has white inner with designed black texture, exterior is a beautiful pink coating. This wok pan also comes with heat insulation handle. Its ergonomic curvature gives you comfortable feeling when hold, and it can also be thermally insulated.

🥗[Easy to Clean & Fast Clean up Mess] Easy to clean is also very important for a frying pan. This wok pan allows you to quickly clean after eating. The only thing you need is a soft sponge, then you can completely clean the frying pan by simply rinsing and wiping few times. Grease and food can be washed off easily. You can still enjoy a relaxing mood after finishing the dishes.

🍳[Nonctick Coating & Healthy Material] This pink wok is suppressed with five layers of 100% free of APEO and PFOA materials. The surface white ceramic coating ensures non-stick characteristics of it. Four internal layers are made of aluminum alloy, allowing this frying pan to heat evenly and more resistant. Each time you cook with this wok pan, you do not need to worry anything about health.

🍟[Valuable Investment & After-Sales Service] KOCH CS is committed to providing customers with professional after-sales service. We are confident that our frying pans are manufactured under strict quality standards to provide the best experience for our customers. Even if you encounter any product problems, we will provide you with intimate after-sales service whenever you need.
